fields.quote: It consists of data from 22 data sources, coarsely broken down into 5 categories
fields.reason: Sources and five coarse categories are listed, but upsampling is mentioned without proportions, so the mixture cannot be reconstructed (not FULL) and disclosure is not NONE.

claims.quote: In Mesh Transformer JAX (Wang, 2021), this led to a 15% throughput increase, while having comparable loss curves
claims.reason: Parallel attention and feed-forward is presented as a known efficiency choice from Wang (2021)/Mesh Transformer JAX, not as a new contribution of this paper.

claims.quote: For the Feed-Forward output layers before the residuals, we used the initialization scheme introduced in Wang (2021)
claims.reason: Both inits are attributed to prior work (Wang 2021 and Nguyen and Salazar 2019); the authors do not claim the scheme as their own.
